report.summary: Requests to POST /checkout are failing with 502/504 errors because orders times out after 400ms waiting for payments POST /charge. Within payments, calls to the external fraud-check provider api.fraudshield.example.com are exceeding their 300ms SLO and failing to respond in time. Because this is caused by an external dependency degradation rather than a code deployment, no rollback is proposed.

The external fraud-check provider api.fraudshield.example.com became unresponsive, exceeding its 300ms SLO during payment processing in the payments service. This caused downstream calls from the orders service to time out after 0.4s and return HTTP 504, resulting in HTTP 502 failures on frontend POST /checkout. No recent deployments occurred across any service, so no rollback is proposed.

Checkout requests failed with 502/504 errors because orders timed out waiting for payments POST /charge. Revision payments-00002 ('chore(deps): bump httpx to 0.28.1') caused outgoing calls to the fraud-check provider (api.fraudshield.example.com) to hang indefinitely, breaching upstream timeouts. Rolling back payments to payments-00001 will resolve the issue.

The external fraud-check provider api.fraudshield.example.com became unresponsive, exceeding its SLO and stalling payments POST /charge requests. Consequently, orders timed out after 0.4s with HTTP 504, causing frontend checkout to fail with HTTP 502. Log evidence confirms the provider latency warnings in payments coinciding with downstream timeout errors in orders and frontend without any recent deployments.
